title: Plug-in call without reference
description: Metadata-integrity check — plug-in calls in files exported with DDR info that never became a reference: a dynamic function name (MBS($name; …)) the converter cannot resolve, or an unresolved chunk pairing. Files exported without DDR info are the finding of "Export without DDR info" and are excluded here.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: A plug-in call that never became a reference is invisible to where-used, the plug-in inventory, platform tests and the docs counters — the import succeeded and nothing points at the gap. Text against graph exposes it per formula and names the cause; the file-level cause (export without DDR info) stays with its own rule so this list holds only the calls that are unresolvable despite a complete export.
rule.remediation: dynamic-name: use a literal function name where the call site allows it — the dynamic form is opaque to every static analysis (where-used, platform tests, docs). unresolved: report the formula — this class is a converter defect. Files without DDR info: see "Export without DDR info".

meta.name: Plug-in call without reference
meta.author: fm-lab rules
meta.description: Formulas in files exported with DDR info that call a plug-in in their text but carry no plug-in reference in the catalog — dynamic function names (info) and unresolved chunk pairings (warning).

references.rule: Save a Copy as XML — Include details for analysis tools

defaultResult.name: finding_count
defaultResult.meaning: Number of formulas in files with DDR info whose plug-in call carries no reference in the catalog — dynamic function names (info) and unresolved pairings (warning)
